title: Arkavo Taxonomy Map v1
description: Versioned mapping from taxonomy labels to OpenTDF attributes. The map is data, not policy: it says which attributes a label implies and what happens to a payload whose requester does not hold them. Authorization itself stays with the KAS and the policy decision point.

version.description: Map version, recorded in sentinel evidence and bound by the pack manifest signature

namespace.description: Attribute namespace every definition FQN extends

attributeDefinitions.description: OpenTDF attribute definitions. Definitions are conjunctive with one another: a requester must satisfy every definition a label names.

rule.description: hierarchy: ordered levels, holding a level grants every lower level. allOf: requester must hold every named value. anyOf: requester must hold at least one.

order.description: Lowest to highest. Required for and only valid on hierarchy definitions.

values.description: Known values. An empty array means the definition is populated per tenant.

labels.description: Taxonomy labels a classifier or reference tier may emit

sensitivity.description: SensitivityLevel floor this label implies. Merging labels takes the maximum.

requires.description: Attributes the requester must hold. Conjunctive across definitions.

wrapAttributes.description: Attributes placed in dataAttributes when a payload carrying this label is wrapped for transport

unentitled.description: Disposition when the requester does not hold the required attributes. Wrapping never rescues an unauthorized disclosure, so allow is not a legal value here.

neverRelease.description: Blocked unconditionally regardless of entitlement, wrapping, or destination

obligations.description: Handling obligations carried as assertions. An obligation constrains what a holder may do with released content; it never grants decryption.

grantsDecryption.description: Always false. An obligation that granted decryption would be an entitlement.
